system.description: You are trained in how to escape bindings, grapples or other holds. Whenever making a roll to escape being tied up or restrained you may benefit from Chakra Surge. If you are being grappled, as an action you may attempt to break the grapple with a Taijutsu roll, benefiting from Chakra Surge, and on a success you end the grapple and may stand if you are prone.
